exposure: Presence of severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) criteria
cohort: The study included pregnant and postpartum women with confirmed COVID-19 who required respiratory support and received care in eight referral centers in northeastern Brazil.
finding: Pregnant and postpartum women with COVID-19 requiring respiratory support were predominantly brown-skinned, in their third trimester, often referred from other hospitals, and experienced high rates of severe acute respiratory syndrome, maternal near miss, and death.
mod_finding: A very high cesarean section rate (91.6%) was observed among the women who required respiratory support.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between April 2020 and December 2021.
gest_age: Predominantly in the third trimester of pregnancy
